They have brought about many changes. It is the best gacha game out there. Definitely worth playing.

The developers employ the strategy of forcing the players to spend real money so they can obtain the new characters, which are always the most powerful and dominate the pvp scene (which is what a player will spend most of his/her time on). The game itself is fun, but the fact that a person is heavily rewarded for playing with their credit card puts free to play players at a major disadvantage.

Great game but it is semi-turn based, which makes a little bit regretful and increase the complicability for playing (but easier for making). The UI could have become better, the connection time for changing a panel is tooo long, and the system is complicated for a mobile game at first sight (have to take time to learn). I have played for two days, didnt spend money and summoned 7 sps. But after I spent money in it I could hardly summon an sp (10000 diamonds for 3sp). Anyway it's full of child memory and comparing to Honkai 3 it seems less money consuming (however Honkai 3 is probably the best act anime game in mobile currently).

An okay game that gets old really quickly. When you reach the higher echelons of the game or PvP, it becomes a very one dimensional game. 1st, it is a gacha game where you hope for a sparkling grade char in your draws. 2nd, at the late game stage, it become the "bait enemy into dodging first so you can dodge their attack then punish them because they cannot dodge anymore" game. Every character fights very similarly in the end. Only variation is the sprite and special move. Gets boring quick.

I installed this game just yesterday, so I haven't played much. This is a really fun game. It is F2P friendly. The PvP is great. The pricing is *kinda* decent. I would love the PvP or the story mode to be a little more....strategic? Where you have to plan out your approach before you get into the fight. As many people have stated, the game is actually reallly slow loading. But besides that the game is great. 4 stars

it's okay for what it is, the battle part is just a time waste tho, even if it's the entire gimmick of this game. Wish you could skip it because it really has no impact, it tries too hard to have different game mechanics to make you feel engaged but it doesn't succeed. The rewards in this game are great and I didn't feel like I had to spend money.

Best game ever,I don't get why people are complaining and saying that you have to spend loadsmof money, thus is a false statement. I haven't spent a penny on this game and I have , so many brilliant sparking characters. To the 1s that say you have to spend alot of time in the game yes it's true but it's fun and the story keeps on going. You think you've completed it then the game makers add extra episodes, an excellent way of keeping you interested in the game. It's the cartoon but playable.

Playing the game for the 4th year and still love it. Although you may not always get the shiny new characters but that's all based on RNG. The graphics and animations are amazing and cool. Great to play during my free time. Although I don't play much pvp, but if you're into challenging battles, you ought to give it a try.

I have been playing the new battle royal game mode and, to be honest I have only been winning but, for some bizarre reason the debs of this game though to add a feature that allows you to disconnect from and online limited edition of PvP battles and not be penalised expect for a warning that is often not upheld. I have currently won 5 battles but I have only been rewarded for 2 of them because of this disconnect exploit that has been around since the last event. I love this game but I'm fed up

A brilliant game that works nicely and updates regularly to keep it interesting. Controls are simple to learn and satisfying to master. Haven't had the need to spend any money on it as you can earn plenty of crystals to see you through the game. Pvp is great but occasionally a bit laggy and rare characters are frustrating to come by but that's why they are rare I guess. A really great game over all.

Pretty decent game. Graphics are nice, gameplay is alright too. Fun to get new characters and level up system isnt too bad either. I grew up with Dragonball so it's nice to see something like this. Things that can be better: UI performance is slow. Improvements in this area would be better to the quality of the game. Navigation is also mediocre at best. Too many clicks between UI screens to get to desired areas. Other game modes such as alliances/groups for more interactive play.hope to see improvements coming up.

I have been enjoying the story mode of the game, although there are pointless battles there sometimes, that have just been implemented to make things take longer. I like how good units keep returning, it's quite entertaining. The thing that I like least is how limited it is to obtain Chrono crystals, there are not many ways, they are very time consuming and the amount you get is too little.

Great game, the art is 10/10 especially great when you summon a sparking, the art really brings home the excitement of getting a rare summon. Something id like them to help with is the downloads, the game is quite big and you have to reserve a lot of space for it, if its possible i think all of us fans would like to see a sort of storage server for the game allowing us to play without downloading as much, beside that setback the game is pretty much perfect, the story is engaging and it runs well

Straight a bad game for free to play. old units never get reworked anymore and they are unusable. Zenkai awakening is not free to play friendly and the strongest units are locked behind zenkai's. Without spending a SIGNIFICANT ( more than i ever seen before in a game) amount of money you will never be able to keep up with the game. edit: the devs put a lot of effort to make this game look gorgeous and put many easter eggs for the fans of the series

Best game for me by far. Been playing for about 5 years now, and still it takes the top spot. Shallot story line, animation & everything else... Insanely good. But I do agree with Aziza Fakir... That could be awesome. Also the collection of Dragon balls. I hardly know people that actually play the game. So scanning the code doesn't really help me, not sure if I'm the only one. But if it where extremely challenging missions/task battles in order to obtain them. I think that could be good move.

Not as good as Dokkan Battle. Legends is a good game but it falls short in several categories. The combat is very simple and gets boring after a while. The summons are the worst part of the game because the rates are always trash. On the other hand, The card art is absolutely spectacular and the inclusion of KaggyFilms playing Shallot was a good one.

Significantly better than when first released. However, currently having problems where specific characters can't be soul boosted. For example, if I try to SB my SP Broly for time sensitive missions it freezes the game right out. It brings me into the sb screen but with only a back button, no other details, and the back button is useless. Fix please

It's a great game. And it gives you the chance to enjoy it without spending any money. But the grinding you need to do in order to do as I said sometimes can be quite tiring. Oh well, there are some people you have all the op characters etc and that's really kinda. Oooof p2w? Whatsoever, as for the mechanics it's a nice game smooth. But I have noticed some random crashes lately: 1. Stack on loading screen forever. 2. Game crashing while on main screen. They are not consistent. Here and there.

Really good game actually, my only complaints are the in game currency to summon is over priced to buy with money. And the game can be a bit laggy at times when your doing pvp, but not the LOL extent lag Haha. My only other one I guess would be is that I would like the stamina bar to fill quicker so I dont have to constantly waste gems filling it. Great game though, I do recommend at least trying it!!

First time I tried getting this game it didn't work, this time however it did and I'm so glad of that. This game is extremely addictive and fun to play. Bit annoyed the harder level bosses can't be beaten without a certain character that you can only get if you complete that levels challenge, otherwise its a great game. Wish we could delete unwanted characters or at least have the option to activate them or not, so many low level unwanted characters.

The graphics are crazy good!!! Gameplay is like that in a console or pc. And the micro transactions are probably unessential... Overall I love the game! And yes the story mode gets kinda boring when one has to read every conversation... It would be better if that thing could be simplified with recorded conversations...

The game is becoming better and better by each update and is a blast to play. My only complains are, that they should release more legends Road characters (more events in general actually), and less daily login challenges, that you can only play once per day. Also, this is far fetched but I wish there was a trading system in which you could trade characters z powers! It would make zenkaing units, and upgrading teams, way easier! It would also give a use for the units that you don't need.

I absolutely love it. This game is awesome and I would recommend it to a dragon ball fan straight away. I love the amount of different characters in it and how you can have all your favourite movie and TV fighters in a powerful team to take on the world in PvP. And you can't describe the feeling of getting a good summon that you've been waiting for for ages!

The game is exceptional in terms of graphics and the combat system, but I believe the devs should consider implementing more options for players to earn gems, as veteran players such as myself find it difficult to earn gems as we have completed most of the missions and events. The game has succeeded as a f2p game, so I hope the devs consider keeping it that way.

Overall very fun just find the free to play aspect a bit lacking once you've played the game for a while and getting the currency used to summon takes a while. With increasingly stronger units with it getting harder and harder to summon most of the time it can be hard to keep up with the new content while getting everything I want which can be frustrating

The game has stunning graphics, authentic voice acting, and epic special moves. However, the game also has some flaws that can be frustrating. The game also requires a lot of grinding and patience to unlock new characters and items, which can be annoying if you don’t want to spend money. The game can also be buggy and laggy, especially in PvP mode. The game is fun and immersive, but it is not perfect.

Best game ever i recommend give it a shot you will not regret it . ;) . (Updated): i am bored of this game new units seem boring and it's getting repitative developers are just adding extra character into game no new features or modes and they reduce the crystals you can gain by quest . The only reason I gave it 2 star is because I had fun playing the game for 1 year I was happy after that it got boring. Update: i no longer play game it's repetitive.

It's gorgeous to look at and the controls are really novel and fun. I'm all for supporting Devs and I've spent money on this game. Unfortunately, the gacha model seems to be the most profitable. It's essentially gambling, but instead of money you're chasing bits and bytes. I'm fond of Dragonball, but without that, I'd steer clear.

This is really solid, I don't have a console and I just got a non-iPhone for the first time and it can actually run games! I tried DBZ dokkan battle before this and it wasn't what I wanted, it was nothing like the 3D combat games I love DBZ for, this is. The controls are maybe too simple and theres way too many push notifications in the app but you actually fight and level up characters in what I imagine is the closest you can get to the original budikai series on a mobile phone!

This game was legit incredible. I haven't came across a gem like this in awhile. Everything about this, is created to a high standard. From the superb graphics and soundtrack, to the story telling and actual fighting mechanics themselves. It is a game you have to play. Nice change of pace from all the pay to win garbage out there. If you enjoy Dragon Ball Z through Super, or fighting games with a slightly more chill and strategic play style. Then this, is the game for you.

Great game with solid battle mechanics, if you could incorporate a concept where we get a sparking every multi that would be great. Helps f2p players and those who cant afford to sink hundreds into a mobile game as pvp is literally a feature for the wallet whales. Also it would be an idea to add a cycle of equipment to the trade shop, every other day or week the shop will cycle to a new set of equipment for purchase. Just a thought.

The best Dragonball mobile game in my opinion. Incredible gameplay, graphics, events and much more. The only reason why I wouldn't rate this a 5 star game is because of the unfair disadvantage of free to play players when it comes to summoning for new characters and then when it comes to unfair match ups in PvP. All in all, it is a good game.

Brilliant graphics, surprisingly fun gameplay. Only downside is that there's SO MANY loading screens, there's even loading screens within loading screens...and the UI is a little cluttered and complex. Plus way too many in-game items that are poorly explained and hard to figure out where, when and how they should be used. In a nutshell, simplify the game a bit.

As a Dragon Ball Z fan, I simply adore this game. It has so many characters to unlock, contains a big story mode for those who DON'T like short story modes. The combat style ressembles like of Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 ( kind of). In other words, the gameplay is amazing ! Although this game does possess a energy meter, you don't have to pay real money to recharge your energy. There are many ways to recharge your energy. This game is worth of 5 stars.

This game could be fantastic in my opinion. I had fun playing it but now, I don't know if I should still be having that. The graphics are gorgeous for a mobile game and the characters are phenomenal. But, this game becomes more and more into pay to win or pay to play. The PvP is awful like you either fight someone that's stronger than you or vice versa. The summon rate is also a shame. It's very hard for me as a dragon ball fan to uninstall this but now I have finally done it. Could be better!

It used to be a great game, very challenging at times. PVP is decent, unless you are a sweaty player, you won't have much luck if fighting against the veterans. Very good gameplay, easy to learn, hard to master. Interesting story with all the all-time characters but expect people to play the meta. With so much characters in this game, most units are useless unless they are part of an event where you are required to use them. Overall, enjoyable experience.

Amazing game! please, bring to us the option to link an equipament to a character, that would help a lot to often change teams, because always that we have to change any character in a team we gotta always equip the equipes on them again, with time it make players avoid to change a character of the team and trying new combinations, please give to us this option! i'd love to see Android 21 in the game as well! :)

Characters, graphics, story, all great, but I think it has fallen off, for there are too many characters with overpowered abilities and mechanics that it gets frustrating very quickly. It is also so luck dependant on not only the summoning but the gameplay as well. There aren't many event options to choose from, meaning you can't farm chrono crystals forcing you to spend money on the game, just to not get the unit you summoned for time and time again. The game is not like it used to be.

Great graphics for a phone game, slight niggles though the worst niggle for me is that some of the guidelines told to you to follow don't always work as well as they should in battle like which colours do more damage to other colours (colours of characters) so when I think I've got the upper hand on a certain colour THEY'RE STILL RAINING IN ALL THIS DAMAGE!-and I'm like what!?-how can you do *THIS* much damage when it's me who has the better colour and mine is fully maxed and yours is not!-???

If there's one thing that should be FIX immediately is PLAYER VS PLAYER! I can't stress you how overly dull and stupid this is due to someone's internet, Either this is intentional or not, it is barely playable if I am facing someone outside of my country. I can't move my character, I have to predict hard, I can't sidestep at times where I could have do it, It is so laggy that it gave the enemy more time than he should to sidestep. Either this is their doing or the game's fault, fix it please.

I'd say that this game is pretty good overall, it provides some challenges, and is great for collecting new characters and learning about them. Although there is two things in this game that I would like to see fixed, one of which is lowering the price of chrono crystals required for summoning, and second I wish summons gave players rarer characters a bit more often. Still a great game though.

It's overall a great game. It's action packed,great graphics,not that complex of a game and animations are smooth and sleek. The only thing that would be nice for the game is an offline mode. There are times I'm out doing something and I want to grind some Chrono Shards but I can't and I don't want to usey data. I think there should be a feature where story mode and summons etc should be available without internet. But that aside it's a amazing game and this is just a suggestion for the game

Best game for the Dragon Ball fans. Awesome graphics! Only little thing is that sometimes while trying to play PvP it takes too long to connect with the opponent. If the opponent is not available then there should be an option to go back to the menu. And I would love if there are little more frequent updates in story.

The game provides a great graphics and really are the best dragon ball game on mobile right now. There are a lot of db characters in the game.however nowadays the game is no longer enjoyable. The game keep limiting the amount of crystal that can be acquired.no more crystal from ultra space time rush. I don't know why but I'm getting really sick of this game. Sincerely from a rabid fan of dragon ball.

Absolutely love the game. Honestly if you're free to play like I am, I recommend getting the game and trying it out and just sticking with it. I've been purely free to play and I've managed to get so many cool characters, and whatsmore they keep making even more cool characters to get in banners. If you find yourself in a place where you're struggling to get primogems, take a break and come back in a little while or see what comes in the events. Honestly, as long as you stick to it, it's fun!

Great game with plenty of rewards for simply playing, my only main issue is something you can entirely ignore and that's the pricing of the Chrono Crystals, they cost far too much for far too little, the conversion rate is a real turn off for me ever wanting to spend money on it, however in spite of that this game succeeds at being a fun game to play and a satisfying gatcha game!

This game pays homage to something beautiful, The true spirit of Dragon Ball. Stunning graphics, completely free to play without any need to make a purchase, but supporting the devs would be awesome. Every character you can think of, literally everyone, blown away. Gives you a realistic DB battle experience. With a story line for a character you can get behind and customise! The total space is large, but worth it, the data the game uses isn't a huge drain, and there is no lag at all! Get it

I feel like I need to update this review: what was previously a rather straightforward progress system made of character limit breaks (boosted by pulling from the gacha), levels, stat upgrades and equipment is now so dreadful it saps all the joy from playing. Progress is now basically meaningless and effortless in everything except gacha pulls. I really used to like this game and gpt excited for new characters, but now I just don't care anymore. Shame.

Been playing this game for 3 months now. It couldn't have been made better and the gameplay is 5 star. Only Downfall is the game creators prioritising on crystal rewards, 150 crystals for 5 Pvp which takes 10 minutes, and then 20 crystals for unlocking 6000 souls which takes a lot of effort and a long time, this is just an example. Many other examples I could list

It's great for me. The characters are cool. The gameplay is awesome, and summoning is cool as well. but my one problem is when I do , let's say 5 missions, I click collect all or something like that it takes a good like 1 - 2 seconds before I can do anything on the game. But yeah, great game. I recommend getting it , its awesome.

I came into this game with high expectations and they definitely delivered! Amazing gameplay, the graphics are appealing and the gameplay simple yet engaging. One thing I would like to request is that they add more ways to acquire any significant amount of chrono crystals as I am struggling to get any 😭. All in all a very good game, would recommend.

I love dragon ball legends. It's a fun game and has an interesting story with lots of other stuff and it's just really cool. The fact that you can train soul boost and upgrade many characters is amazing. One thing I would say is that the game is so big and takes lots of space on my device disallowing me to play and download other apps so it would really mean a lot if you could find a way to make the game less huge. Other than that it's one of my favourite games and I hope you reply to my review!

A very fun game that gives you the choice to play online against other players or versus AI. However it is a bit difficult for new players as most of the playable characters are unavailable and upgrades are expensive. Despite this the story is great and goes through all events in the anime and has characters from the first episode of Dragon Ball to the last episode of the Tournament of Power (ep 131). Some other modes and matches require you to complete a specific story level to unlock them.

Amazing game! Probably the easiest to pick jp, but hard to master. This game is amazing, however theres two things that bug me about it, #1 the need for internet even if your doing the campaign or any of that, and number two at first you practically have no clue what half the stuff does, then when you learn it they decide to after give a tutorial. And the campaign early on is too easy. Otherwise it would be 5 stars

Great game but arts boosts kills the game for me (look at reddit and you'll see what I mean). I played this game since release and I played it consistently and very often and found lots of enjoyment. I refuse to grind and waste my life arts boosting units to make them as strong as they were before, it's awful and I cba to play the game. It's killed the game for me so I wouldn't recommend downloading unless you want to spend 900 years grinding

Every time I open the game I spend 80% of my time pressing menus, accepting "gifts", or reading "super important notices"... and by the time I finally get to playing the actual game, I feel so exhausted, I lose interest. I've tried this many times, I love Dragonball, and this game has all the potential to be good, but the clutter and over-gamification, over-questification just wastes all my energy on the wrong things.

Absolutely solid game. However, I wish that the controls were better and that we could access the game with Wi-Fi easily. Other than that I have no qualms with the game. Edit: They fixed the Wi-Fi problem quite fast. Edit 2: I am reducing my rating to 1 star because of the fact that the new Zenkai system is very f2p unfriendly and that it requires a lot of boring grind. Edit: I've come to terms with it

As the big dragon ball fan that i am, i absolutely love this game and spend alot of time playing it, one of my only complaints is how long it takes to grind chrono crystals when there's no story, this really puts me down and not want to play for a while, especially when a new thing comes out like Super Gogetas Zenkai that i now can't do due to lack of crystals, and the price to buy them is extremely expensive. Other than that, this is an amazing game and i 100% recommend it to any DB Fan.

Excellent game, I still believe that summons could be improved. I completely dislike the consecutive 10 summoning which uses 1000 gems. We should be guaranteed a sparking character otherwise, it's such a waste of gems. It would be nice if we could get, at most 3 guaranteed sparking characters everytime we did a consecutive 10 summoning. I also dislike the fact that we cannot get characters that were available in previous packs. There should be a pack always available where any character on the list is generated at random, that being all characters available. Once this part has been implemented I will give my deserving 5 stars, because honestly I do believe this is a great game. I've been a fan of this anime since I was 7 years old.

I love the graphic the most, one of the best anime style games based on graphics. As for gameplay, unique mechanisms, not too easy and not too hard. The grinding for this game is easy compared to other anime games. Level is easy to raise, equipment easy to grind. But, to max out the equipment is kinda a hassle. Playing during event help out a lot since they provide the required materials. The storyline, it is unique, and we can customise the main character skills and more. 9.5/10!

I really enjoy the game! It has really good graphics (For a mobile game.) and amazing art! Also the way they handle Shallot is one of the best for a free to play unit. The Gameplay also feels really nice for a mobile game. There is one big problem though, the online. Even with the update the online can often be laggy and you can run into whales (People that spend an Extreme amount of money.) very often. That isn't fun because it's pretty much impossible to win.

I love the game, the animations, the art, everything is just amazing. i love the fighting style, its very easy to control! one thing i've seen other people talk about a lot and i have experienced myself. when you play against the Al and use a skill arts combo, they just dodge in the middle of the attack. there's no way any actual player can do that! and when they use their combo against you, it just keeps going until the attack is over. so please fix that. overall, it's a good game. recommended.

Despite the game being really great due to storyline and characters, the players here are unhinged, they always use Ultras and unfair mechanics, I can't even play pvp peacefully, all I want is to use other characters rather than using overpowered characters, I only played for fun, but it doesn't matter about my choices and words, I have a really bad struggle in pvp. Great game anyway.

Ok where do i start? This game is the best dragon ball game u can get on mobile forget Dokkan battle. The Plot is simple in dbl egends and the gameplay is 100/10 rating. One important detail i forgot to add that i l know alot of you will like to hear is the fact that is ad free. The events are fun and some are challenging. I have played this game for a while and i have never once thought of deleting it. Download the game. You wont regret. Oh and pack luck might gt bad after while of playing!

Large content, full of modes and events. Deep DB roster, the biggest in a dB game i have seen. Level up is very easy (a bit broken imo) for pve, but at the end it can be something optional. Gameplay is original. Mixes action and strategy in an ez way to get superfluously but hard to master (cancels, sidesteps etc). This makes it somewhat addictive and not very repetitive although exploiting certain things can make it. The cards rng can make the plot twist. Incredible graphics, good drop rates

I obviously like this game as its free,cheap in game items and the graphics.Dokkan battle was far worse than this game. It has apropriate plot and the new character shallot has good transformations. Only thing I would recomend is that you should add more of those ultra characters. My name is Rehaan(also in the game) suggest some tricks too. Peace.

This game is really great. It has great graphics for a mobile, a ton of content and depth. Don't listen to those who say it's pay to win, cause it really isn't. If you want a certain character, chances your going to get it, and the game provides many ways to get Chrono Crystals, which are what you use to get new or upgraded characters. Overall this game is really good you should definitely check it out

Im not really a gatcha game person but I am having a lot of fun with DBL. There is a sizable amount of single player content with a story that has piqued my interest. The combat has enough depth to it that I actually feel like Im doing something and can make strategic decisions, with fights not completely dependent on having the best characters. The shop is expensive, but the game is quite generous with it's premium currency as long as you spend it wisely.

Simply Splendid....being a DB fan makes me feel happy playing this game coz it's just awesome. Although, i feel somethings missing somewhere. Like upto where I've played until now, art attacks cannot be countered, also the interaction is more with art attacks due to faster ki generation than usual. The combos on physical attacks is repeated which do not give much to please. Maybe this is what lacking in the game

Best Dragon ball game. Nice Story. I am only confused from so many duplicate of Carachters. I think there are more than 20 goku or 10 freezer. Would be nice to have less double not necessary Carachters. Give us the opportunity to fuse them and swap the Art card and costumes. Basically there is a Goku for every battle he made. We won't use all of them. C18 for example. 3 are enough. The rest is just clothes. Is it possible to add something to the Guild? For now is almost useless.

It's a Great Game. Visually stunning and pretty fun. The only problem with it is there is a big difference when you're going for PvP since the Pay To Play Players have characters that are almost unbeatable while Players who doesn't have the means of getting the "crystals" are stuck with just luck. It's lucky to get a good character with the limited tickets that are given for free. While PTP Players basically gets the best Character while upgrading the other already OP Characters in the process.

I love this game except that sometimes it takes forever to load. And sometimes they upgrade the characters too much that it makes the fighting too easy wasting the energy bars which are needed to fight. And sometimes when I win a battle it will kick me out of the game and say that I have a network issue. Please fix this. Other than all this, this game is great. I love the drawings. KEEP IT UP!🙂

Absolutely great game. Especially if you like any on the Dragonball series. For my personally i wish they could do something about the controls as it feels sometimes like it doesn't react or do as you wish. For the rest great game it gives you a real Dragonball feel! Unfortunately after the last update the game keeps crashing after the title screen on my Samsung Galaxy S10. So can't recommend it until they fix that bug!

This game is super addictive and if you're a Dragonball fan youre definitely gonna love it, the animations are amazing graphics are decent overall a decent game. One thing I do HATE about the game is how it is to get new characters you spend half your day farming chrono crystals (the currency of the game) just to get shafted (not get the new character) so that's why it's a 4 stars for me, try the game out you'll see for yourself.

The game overall is awesome for casual players and crazy dragonball fans! It's fast pace and really gets the adrenaline running. The game is fluid when there aren't any lag issues while playing pvp. As for the art, it just really brings something else to the table compared to other mobile games. When it comes to grinding souls, zeni or exp, it doesn't feel overwhelming and is truly a great game! 5* for me!

Curious. I wrote a review already. Here it is again: The game is mostly enjoyable. I say mostly, because some battles are WAY too stacked against the players to the point of absurdity. The rewards are too low to be worth any effort. I understand that games needs to present a challenge to feel worthwhile but in some battles it's like fighting characters who are using cheat codes. Games are for relieving stress, not causing it. Please consider reducing the difficulty levels and I'll give 5 stars.

This is by far the best anyone could ask for in a mobile DB game and more! The only thing it's lacking is slightly more diverse tap combat. In other words, it would be cool if you could do a little more when tapping the screen to attack. Maybe a longer combo string or a follow up attack at the cost of ki or something? Just a suggestion, but still, one of the coolest dbz games around, and I've played them all 😬

This game is honestly a lot of work especially if you're going in without a wallet to help. But there now are ways to learn how to fight with the Trunks lecture and you can get chrono crystals from the various exchanges in the exchange shop and events. I would also advise watching how the YouTubers play to understand how the game is best played. Overall it's a very fun game but will take a while to get the hang of.

The game is amazing, but it crashes a lot. Whenever I summon more cards or when I start a fight, it crashes. I figured I could deal with it because I can start again right where I left off, but now I can't progress in the story. In book 4 chapter one, whenever I kill the first saibaman, the game crashes. This means that I can't unlock multiplayer battles and duels. Will give 5 Stars once the problem is solved

This game is great, the animation is incredible and there is a lot of quality of life stuff (like a skip button for summons). But, of course, it is a gacha so you need either luck or money to be up to date. This game can also be incredibly frustrating, as it is PVP and almost every time a new unit is released, it becomes impossible to win matches without them. 10/10 would recommend

Great game, great graphics and story mode, lots to do, and many characters to collect. Graphics are pretty nice, content added frequently, but if you don't have really good WiFi/data speeds, you aren't gonna have fun, due to the game simply not being able to register your inputs fast enough or even at all at times. PvP can also have trouble matchmaking, but then you get into a match and there are still connection problems. Good if you have fast WiFi but irritating without.

The story missions and events are a ton of fun, but the PVP is pretty terrible. There's potential there, but there's really no point in playing outside of gathering "adventure" missions. It all comes down to luck, and hoping the matchmaking system favors you. I've literally been matched up with characters that I killed with a single Strike attack - no strategy or skill involved. The gameplay has some Rock Paper Scissors dynamics, but it's all undermined by the lack of fair battles. The single player AI isn't any better, as during later difficulties it becomes blatant that they're reading your inputs, and they have a reaction time that's instantaneous.

I have been playing the game for a few months now, and I have started playing the game because of how incredible the art was, how much content was brought out, and how friendly the game was to all sorts of players(no matter if they're paying for content or not) however, the game has admittedly taken a turn, but not for the better. The game has been running into long dry periods where content and rewards are scarce; from getting fresh new stories and rewards that gave players the incentive to play continuously on a weekly basis, the game has turned into a desert where players have to scrape the bottom of the barrel just so they can get crystals(which isn't even enough for a multi summon anymore, mind you) Another thing is that the PVP system has become a far cry from its former self; from being an environment that requires the players to strategically play and at often times to create new fun ways of playing, it has evolved into an uninspiring grindfest that's filled to the brim with bugs and exploits that take the fun out of the game.

In my opinion I think this game should add clans and team battles.

Was a very enjoyable game at first, but now in PvP more and more people exploit dash and ki cancelling which has ruined the fun element. Hybrid teams are destroying some characters in 3 hits without even having any colour advantage and new hard event missions are just consisting of cheating AI that follow different game rules to the player in a lazy attempt to create difficulty. I used to enjoy PvP but with the way the game is played by most people now, using gameplay mechanic exploits to allow combos higher than 4 hits and KO chars in a single combo, I've lost interest.

This game is a great skilled based fighting game where you use special cards to attack the opponent. You can summon characters which have extra cards and the currency is quite easy to earn until you get far into the game. The story is great and rewards you with a free character which is better than most summonable characters, and he gets upgraded as you complete the story. He is also customisable as you can change his ultimate attack, clothing and transformation. 10/10

While the game has nice graphics the moves available in combat are too limited. It would also be nice to unlock more cards for each character as you play more and more with them. The biggest problem I would say is the loading times... Even with a full download there are loading times eveywhere ...... Super annoying, have never experienced this in other games

I really love this game, been playing it non-stop for 4 days now since my pc is broken. I like the fighting system, though I haven't exactly tried PVP, cause I haven't really gotten that far in my story mode but still, It's fun nontheless. I also love the fact that when you hold a character long enough, it shows you special effect and that's sick asf, like honestly. Also, please make the game atleast 4gb if that's perhaps possible because I have a small storage, so 5gb is not really that ideal

I'll give the game 4 out of 5 stars The game's visuals and performance are just stunning,the music is great, and the story itself is interesting. However....the method of collecting Chrono Crystals can be quite tedious and takes quite a while to obtain the amount needed, but overall it's definitely the best Dragon Ball on Mobile

Dragon Ball Legends is a fast-paced mobile fighting game featuring iconic characters from the Dragon Ball series. With real-time combat and card-based mechanics, players can battle through story mode or engage in PvP. The game offers a unique narrative with original character Shallot, though the gacha system can feel grindy. Overall, it’s a fun experience for Dragon Ball fans, but in-app purchases may be a drawback for some.

Animations are great. Characters kits, especially the newer ones are really good too. Only problem is the game's lack of consideration for the older F2P Players. If it releases more events from which the valuable ingame currency Chrono Crystals(CC) can be amassed, like a Chrono Crystal bonus battle or a high difficulty event that can be played repeatedly without skip tickets. I think such things would immensely boost the game's potential and allow everyone to enjoy the game to its fullest!

It's still a good game to me but.. since the last updates, it's being more annoying with getting sparkings from chrono crystals. It feels like they made it much harder to get a sparking. Such an amazing game. Actually, it's more than a game. It has become a part of my life. There is an incredible story line, and it's always being developed, keeping the user interested. It's amazing.

This game is hands down the best dragon ball game on moblie though it still has its flaws. Some people might disagree, but I think this is the single best, most well-made app game ever uploaded to the Play Store. You can tell they've put a lot of thought into it. They grabbed a lot of criticism from Dokkan, another DragonBall game, and improved a lot of things. The interface is beautiful. The app is responsive, although a bit heavy on the storage (I'm currently at 1GB and I chose the Minimal Installation option, I'm Rank 40). The fighting system is pretty well built for a gacha game, the summons are super exciting, character variety is alright, although I'm sure they'll keep adding characters (at this time, for example, SSB Vegito, Goku Ultra Instinct, and a few others are missing). But there's still plenty to choose from for a viable team. You have about 5 or 6 top teams that are viable in PVP. The PVP itself is also really good in my opinion. Fast paced and exciting. I have an 80$ smartphone and I'm able to enjoy the battles with some minor input lag once in a while, so anyone with a better smartphone will probably face little to no problems with battles. Overall I'm super in love with this game so far.
